==Description==
The '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Fallen King''' was a character figure that can be obtained from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12''. It was released in July of 2022. This toy is based on [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]], more specifically the October 2020 design added in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''From Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12'''
*:Assemble the ultimate Roblox toy collection with these iconic characters from your favorite experiences! There are 24 new figures from Series 12 and each comes with a code for an exclusive virtual item that can be redeemed on Roblox. Collect them all!

==Prices & Stores==
The ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12'' has 24 figures that may be included. As you cannot guarantee what toy you get from the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12'', there is no fixed price for the '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Fallen King'''.

The rarity of this item is also unknown as each figure does not have the same rarity.

The costs and stores listed are for one purchase of the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12'', unless stated otherwise. Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $24.99-$32.99 in the US, £4.99-£22.70 in the UK and €25.75 in the EU. 

The stores in which you can buy the ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 2'' depends on each country. The toy is subject to availability.

The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensible list:

*[https://www.amazon.com/Roblox-Mystery-Figure-Pack-Style/dp/B09P8YJL5Z Amazon] (6-Pack, Worldwide)
*[https://www.walmart.com/ip/Roblox-Series-12-Mystery-Figure-Includes-1-Figure-1-Exclusive-Virtual-Item/5244325707 Walmart] (6-Pack, US, Canada & Mexico)

==Trivia==
*Oddly enough, on the Jazwares website the '''Roblox Mystery Figure - Fallen King''' does not appear in the list of all the figures you can obtain from ''Roblox Mystery Figure Pack - Series 12''.
*The design of the figurine closely resembles the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] design from October 2020 ([[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]).
